app.name: Cornelius
app.tagline: Review, learn, and teach from recorded operations.
app.positioning: For retrospective review, education, and research. Not for real-time or patient-specific clinical guidance.

aboutModel.title: About the model
aboutModel.intro: Analysis is available for the procedures below. Phase and instrument labels, their colors, and the reported performance come from the deployed model version.
aboutModel.disclaimer: Scene events are heuristic and intended for post-operative review and training, not real-time clinical guidance.
